Medical History

- Current health concerns and risk factors:  
  - Chest tightness for approximately three hours

  - Wheezy chest and persistent non-productive cough following recent upper respiratory infection (cold with sore throat, runny nose resolving)  
  - Asthma diagnosis from youth with prior severe exacerbation requiring intubation and hospital admission (age 16–17)  
  - Recent lack of asthma medication use due to running out of inhalers one week ago

Management Plan

- Prescribed Salbutamol (Ventolin) and Clenil Modulite inhalers with instructions to resume Clenil daily and use Ventolin as needed  
- Oral corticosteroid tablets prescribed (two tablets in the morning for five days) to reduce asthma exacerbation symptoms; patient advised on potential side effects and to read medication label  
- Provided education on proper inhaler and spacer use; will send spacer device with instructions

- Suggested rest and offered up to seven days off work with self-certification initially
